content:
By default, Tenable Vulnerability Management is configured with a region-specific cloud scanner. In
addition to the default cloud scanner, you can link Nessus scanners, NNM scanners, and Nessus
Agents.
The API enables you to manage scanners, including listing scanners, retrieving scanner details,
updating settings, deleting scanners, obtaining scanner linking keys, and listing AWS scan targets.
For more information about scanners, see View Linked Scanners in the Tenable Vulnerability
Management User Guide.
